title: Excalidraw Studio
description: Local-first Excalidraw diagram studio: draw manually on a full offline canvas, generate or revise .excalidraw diagrams with AI, and browse, preview, rename, and export workspace diagram files.
author: Lumzel

params.label: Default Diagrams Folder
params.description: Relative workspace directory where newly created or AI-generated .excalidraw files are saved.

zh-CN.label: 默认图表目录
zh-CN.description: 新建或由 AI 生成的 .excalidraw 文件默认保存的相对目录。

params.label: Default AI Diagram Type
params.description: Preferred diagram style pre-selected in the AI generator dialog.

zh-CN.label: 默认 AI 生图类型
zh-CN.description: 在 AI 生成弹窗中默认选中的图表类型。

params.label: Auto-save Canvas Edits
params.description: Automatically write manual canvas changes back to the active .excalidraw file after a short pause.

zh-CN.label: 自动保存画布修改
zh-CN.description: 手动编辑画布后自动防抖写回当前打开的 .excalidraw 文件。

en.title: Excalidraw Studio
en.description: Local-first Excalidraw diagram studio: draw manually on a full offline canvas, generate or revise .excalidraw diagrams with AI, and browse, preview, rename, and export workspace diagram files.

zh-CN.title: Excalidraw 画布工作台
zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 Excalidraw 图表工作台：完整离线手绘画布、支持手动绘制与 AI 生成/修订图表，统一管理、预览、重命名与导出工作区 .excalidraw 文件。
